description: STRONG BRASS BODY: Constructed with a premium brass body, the DL65 offers superior durability and a sturdy grip. This robust design is built to endure tough conditions, making the flashlight ideal for long-term use in outdoor environments, emergencies, and rugged conditions. TRIPLE BATTERY CONFIGURATION: This torch runs on four D size batteries, delivering stable power for extended use. This system ensures consistent performance and longer runtime, making it ideal for regular and emergency use. To make things easier, all required batteries are included free in the pack, eliminating the need for a separate purchase. CLASSIC RETRO DESIGN: Combining a vintage brass finish with a functional, easy-to-carry grip design, this torch reflects Eveready’s legacy of over 100 years in quality torch manufacturing—built on innovation, durability, and a commitment to sustainability. DUAL LIGHT MODES: DL65 features two lighting modes: a steady focused beam and a flasher function. The main beam is controlled through a slide-and-lock switch, while the flasher is activated using the side button built into the same switch for quick and easy access. SLIDE AND LOCK SWITCH: Equipped with a smooth slide-and-lock switch that ensures easy and secure operation. It locks firmly in place to avoid accidental activation, offering dependable control and convenience during extended use. ERGONOMIC DESIGN: The DL65’s cylindrical, textured brass body fits naturally in your hand for a steady hold. Its ribbed surface offers better grip, while the well-placed switch allows easy one-hand use, built for comfort, control, and everyday ease. EASY HOOK: The DL65 features a slim metal hook near the base, allowing for quick hanging and convenient storage. It adds to carrying ease and keeps the torch accessible when not in use. TRUSTED BY PROFESSIONALS: Preferred by security guards, farmers, and mechanics, the DL65 offers powerful lighting for everyday jobs like outdoor work, maintenance, and security.
